'Last runs' says 'Routing — No new routing suggestions.', so no routing card, routing evidence or routing diff is visible.

The Schedule and jobs card runs past the bottom of the viewport, so a button at about y≈890 is only partly visible. It should be reachable by scrolling, but this screenshot can't confirm that the content pane scrolls.

The 'Run nightly at' time field (03:00 AM) and the Memory care 'Apply and tell me' dropdown look greyed out and have low contrast. That looks deliberate because their checkboxes are off, but the text is faint.

The Last runs card is much shorter than the Schedule and jobs card, which leaves a large empty space under it on the right.
